name: Luna Loud
source:
Luna is the third eldest in the family and the coolest of all my sisters! Luna's a rockstar with her own band, the Moon Goats! They play all around town, and Luna is not only lead guitar, but the lead singer as well! Luna's always had a thing for music, and she can play any instrument you put in front of her!

She also loves British culture, and most importantly, rockstar Mick Swagger! Luna's always been someone [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]I[/url] can confide in and talk to. She's one of the most level headed of my sisters, even if she loves partying and making noise!

Luna's also unique among all of us in that she's bi! It wasn't a big deal when we found out, but Luna's always been attracted to both guys and girls. Right now she's dating one of her bandmates, a girl named Sam. When not talking in a fake British accent, Luna's favorite phrases are "[i]Dude[/i]" and "[i]bruh[/i]"!

[In game description]
